question: Please help me find the names of top 5 players with the highest average runs per match in season 5, along with their batting averages.
sql:
SELECT p.player_name, 
       ROUND(1.0 * SUM(bs.runs_scored) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id), 2) as avg_runs_per_match
FROM match m
JOIN ball_by_ball bbb ON m.match_id = bbb.match_id 
    AND m.season_id = 5
JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id 
    AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id 
    AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
    AND bbb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
JOIN player p ON bbb.striker = p.player_id
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY 1.0 * SUM(bs.runs_scored) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id) DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT p.player_id, p.player_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id) as matches_played, 
       SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
FROM match m
JOIN ball_by_ball bbb ON m.match_id = bbb.match_id
JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id 
    AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id 
    AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
    AND bbb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
JOIN player p ON bbb.striker = p.player_id
WHERE m.season_id = 5
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY 1.0 * SUM(bs.runs_scored) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id) DESC
LIMIT 10

args.sql:
SELECT p.player_name, 
       ROUND(1.0 * SUM(bs.runs_scored) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id), 2) as avg_runs_per_match
FROM match m
JOIN ball_by_ball bbb ON m.match_id = bbb.match_id 
    AND m.season_id = 5
JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id 
    AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id 
    AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
    AND bbb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
JOIN player p ON bbb.striker = p.player_id
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY 1.0 * SUM(bs.runs_scored) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id) DESC
LIMIT 5
